title: Post-Exploitation on Targets with No Outbound Access After RCE
description: How to exfiltrate data when JNDI fails and there is no callback path
detail: 1. Time-based blind injection: place the command in a sleep call and use response delay as an oracle to read files character by character (write the decision script yourself, one request per bit/character). 2. Write to the web root: when the target runs its own httpd, write cat /flag to the site directory and then read it with curl 127.0.0.1. 3. Borrow application echo: find the application's own echo parameter (ping output, search results page) and carry command output through it. 4. Header differential: write output length into a Content-Length differential for inference. 5. When everything else fails: turn execution into arbitrary read — split the results of find / -name '*flag*' into chunks, write them to application logs, then read the logs. Core idea: exfiltrate data without relying on outbound network access.
